purpose: Let any participant that can make HTTP requests learn what this environment is and act in it, without a provider-specific prompt.

outside: substrate, PURL and ACSP internals (reached through adapters)

invariants.text: Every route the circle serves is listed at /sdk, and /sdk lists itself and its own constitution.
GET never changes state anywhere; every mutation is a POST to a listed route.
The SDK assumes no model provider: no route, schema or text names one as a requirement.
A prompt is a program only if it satisfies the prompt contract; classification never executes.
The SDK's provenance (file hashes, commit) is served with it.

permitted_transitions: POST a listed POST route with a declared session
forbidden_transitions: acting on a credential passed in a URL
publishing beyond an ACSP pending proposal
executing a classified prompt as a side effect of classification
non_effects: /observatory and /tests derive from existing records and store nothing
validation_method: the conformance runner (POST /conformance/runs); checks named above
evidence_requirements: a conformance run in which every mechanical invariant's check passed against a live circle
